comment: Every card is INVENTED so the model cannot answer from training recall: the fact that decides each need-scenario exists only behind a tool. Each need-scenario also runs as a TWIN with the fact printed in the state ({FACT}); the twin measures restraint and is the comprehension ceiling for the answer. cls=plain has nothing hidden. `needs` lists alternatives; each alternative is a set of [tool regex, argument regex] lookups that must all have executed. `oracle` is one sufficient call sequence, used by the offline oracle policy to prove every scenario is solvable through each protocol. `hidden` are the deciding strings: absent from the need prompt, present in the twin (test-enforced).
